purpose.en: Build the back of the arms and the chest.

text.zh: 肘直直向后弯，肩远离耳朵
text.en: Bend your elbows straight back and keep your shoulders down

text.zh: 双手撑在椅面前沿，屈膝双脚踩地
text.en: Hands on the front edge of the seat, knees bent, feet flat.

text.zh: 下到大臂约与地面平行，再推回伸直
text.en: Lower until your upper arms are about level, then press back up.

commonErrors.en: Shrugging or letting the shoulders roll forward.

cautions.zh: 肩前侧夹痛时缩小幅度或换简单版本
cautions.en: If the front of your shoulder pinches, reduce the range or switch to an easier version.

cautions.zh: 使用稳固、不带轮子的椅子
cautions.en: Use a sturdy chair without wheels.
